Source Title: Future-Focused Control Barrier Functions for Autonomous Vehicle Control
Authors: Mitchell Black; Mrdjan Jankovic; Abhishek Sharma; Dimitra Panagou
Reason: Has a reactive quadratic-program controller that enforces future-focused CBF constraints but never builds an RRT* and uses no LQR-based steering metric. Fails Criterion 1.
Full: The paper offers a reactive quadratic-program controller that enforces future-focused CBF constraints (see Eq. 5) but never builds or expands an RRT* (or any asymptotically-optimal sampling tree) and uses no LQR-based steering metric. Because it lacks the required hybrid LQR–CBF–RRT* architecture, it fails Criterion 1 and is therefore excluded despite meeting the other criteria.
